##### Project general facts

Muraba Veil is a landmark residential development by Muraba Properties that redefines vertical luxury living in Dubai. Rising 380 meters across 73 storeys, the tower is an architectural masterpiece designed by the internationally renowned consultancy WSP Parsons Brinckerhoff. With its elegant silhouette and striking contemporary design, Muraba Veil offers an exclusive collection of residences that combine exceptional craftsmanship with breathtaking panoramic views of the Dubai skyline. Every aspect of the project reflects a commitment to timeless architecture, innovation, and sophisticated urban living.

The development is designed to deliver an elevated residential experience where privacy, comfort, and contemporary elegance come together. Expansive layouts, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and carefully considered architectural details maximize natural light while framing spectacular city views. Positioned in one of Dubai's most prestigious locations, Muraba Veil offers residents seamless access to the city's premier business, retail, and leisure destinations while maintaining an atmosphere of exclusivity and tranquility.

Each residence is finished with premium-quality contemporary materials that emphasize refined simplicity and lasting elegance. The apartments feature fully equipped kitchens and are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners the freedom to create interiors that reflect their individual style while complementing the building's sophisticated architectural character.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Wasl, situated in the prestigious City Walk district, is a vibrant and upscale urban destination that effortlessly blends modernity with a touch of classic charm. This dynamic area is renowned for its cosmopolitan atmosphere, world-class shopping, and a myriad of dining options that cater to diverse tastes.

Within Al Wasl, you'll find a harmonious mix of contemporary architecture and lush green spaces, creating an inviting ambiance for residents and visitors alike. Strolling through its pedestrian-friendly streets, you'll encounter a wealth of boutiques, cafes, and cultural attractions that make every visit a unique experience.

Al Wasl is not just a place to live or visit - it's a lifestyle that embodies the spirit of Dubai's cosmopolitan identity. With its central location and a plethora of amenities, it offers a vibrant urban living experience that's second to none.
